protocol.natural_gc_log_policy: Pilot on; then alternate off/on. All processes fresh, same frozen baseline file, normal35s bounded teardown.

protocol.6500ms_scope: Descriptive investigation bucket derived from retained prior tails, not an acceptance or exclusion threshold and not proof of a common cause.
protocol.instrumentation: Existing official entries read once after completion; no inter-action hooks, functional observer, runtime TRACE or PERF forced collection. Diagnostic FRAME observation enabled by driver.
protocol.contention: Diagnostic-only runs overlap frozen-v2 conformance CPUs0–3 where active and root-announced background suite CPUs6–9/x64 validation CPUs15–18 where active. None are idle-machine timing comparisons.

limitations: All records retained; diagnostic durations do not establish performance gains or losses.
Performance measures bracket marks, while official action numbers bracket separate performance.now reads; differences retained.
Clock residual is checked at completion; stderr receipt adds buffering/scheduling and cannot timestamp GC start or pause.
Native GC lines expose cause/live/reclaimed counts but no pause time or compilation totals. Sampler forced-GC compilation reports are separate.
Natural-GC logging and diagnostic frame observations can affect occurrence. Small alternating companions do not isolate logging causality.
No injected state-checker/hash loop runs, and no optimizing execution inferred from this default-off diagnostic.
